allowed_actions: Read public pinned sources and search independent original standards
Analyze and falsify competing Sandbox/TESSERACT architectures
Produce quarantined expert research returns through operator bridge
Run synthetic offline tests only within separately authorized own environment
prohibited_actions: Write or create folders in governed public GitHub repository
Connect to OPPO or run sensors, ADB, Type-C host actions, recording or calibration
Merge PR355 PR356 or current R29 draft and deploy Hostinger
Reuse unregistered R27E write slots or create agents and permissions
Quote or reconstruct unobserved private source bytes

mission.question: Under independent formal, provenance and adversarial tests does a typed TESSERACT-8 research graph genuinely outperform simpler alternatives while preserving C1 and actor/real device hard gates?
falsifiers: N12 rank proof known vs unknown gravity inputs
F01-F26 predeclared adversarial and positive control matrix
Common model/provider/source path shows false independence
Clock-domain and consent failure prevents false physical run
TESSERACT-8 has unmeasured overhead or more false positives than minimal Task Anchor baseline
acceptance_tests: All sources source-exact or evidence-limited declared
All planned tests separated from actually executed offline tests
Formal known-orientation rank-12 positive control accompanied by unknown-pose counterclaim
No unsupported performance percentage or C2 claim
Independent receiver rehash required before authority label
pause_conditions: Private source required for claim but unavailable
Real device receipt/host consent absent and physical test proposed
Source contains secret personal data or unlicensed full text
not_executed: R29 26-fixture executable implementation on actual target environment
Any merge or WWW Hostinger deploy

drift_triggers: Authority scope claimed beyond read-only research
Static test falsely upgraded to real sensor observation
Claim promotion without source and authorization
History rewritten instead of append-only successor

F01-F26 test execution transparently separated from design coverage
